import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 998244353;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int[] first = new int[3];
        int[] second = new int[3];

        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            first[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            second[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }

        int maxScore = maximum(first, second);
        int minScore = minimum(n, first, second);
        System.out.println(minScore + " " + maxScore);
        sc.close();
    }

    static int[] factors(int n) {
        Set<Integer> factorsSet = new HashSet<>();
        for (int i = 1; i <= Math.sqrt(n); i++) {
            if (n % i == 0) {
                factorsSet.add(i);
                factorsSet.add(n / i);
            }
        }
        List<Integer> list = new ArrayList<>(factorsSet);
        Collections.sort(list);
        return list.stream().mapToInt(i -> i).toArray();
    }

    static int invMod(int n) {
        return pow(n, MOD - 2);
    }

    static int pow(int base, int exp) {
        int result = 1;
        int cur = base % MOD;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = (int) ((long) result * cur % MOD);
            }
            cur = (int) ((long) cur * cur % MOD);
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    static int maximum(int[] rock, int[] sci, int[] paper) {
        int res = Math.min(rock[0], sci[1]) + Math.min(sci[0], paper[2]) + Math.min(paper[0], rock[2]);
        return res;
    }

    static int match(int a, int b) {
        if (a == b) return 0;
        if ((a == 1 && b == 2) || (a == 2 && b == 3) || (a == 3 && b == 1))
            return 1;
        else
            return -1;
    }

    static int give(List<int[]> l1, List<int[]> l2) {
        int ans = 0;
        Deque<int[]> stack1 = new ArrayDeque<>();
        Deque<int[]> stack2 = new ArrayDeque<>();
        for (int[] item : l1) {
            stack1.push(item);
        }
        for (int[] item : l2) {
            stack2.push(item);
        }

        int[] curr1 = null, curr2 = null;

        while (!stack1.isEmpty() || !stack2.isEmpty()) {
            try {
                if (curr1 == null) curr1 = stack1.pop();
                if (curr2 == null) curr2 = stack2.pop();
            } catch (NoSuchElementException e) {
                break;
            }

            int minVal = Math.min(curr1[0], curr2[0]);
            int m = match(curr1[1], curr2[1]);
            ans += Math.max(0, minVal * m);

            if (curr1[0] < curr2[0]) {
                curr2[0] -= curr1[0];
                curr1 = null;
            } else if (curr1[0] > curr2[0]) {
                curr1[0] -= curr2[0];
                curr2 = null;
            } else {
                curr1 = null;
                curr2 = null;
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static int minimum(int n, int[] rock, int[] sci, int[] paper) {
        int ans = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        int[][] perms = {
                {0, 1, 2},
                {0, 2, 1},
                {1, 0, 2},
                {1, 2, 0},
                {2, 0, 1},
                {2, 1, 0}
        };

        int[][] l1Perms = generatePermutations(rock, sci, paper);
        int[][] l2Perms = generatePermutations(rock, sci, paper);

        for (int[] perm1 : l1Perms) {
            for (int[] perm2 : l2Perms) {
                List<int[]> list1 = new ArrayList<>();
                List<int[]> list2 = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int idx : perms[0]) {
                    list1.add(new int[]{perm1[idx], idx + 1});
                }
                for (int idx : perms[0]) {
                    list2.add(new int[]{perm2[idx], idx + 1});
                }
                ans = Math.min(ans, give(list1, list2));
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static int[][] generatePermutations(int[] rock, int[] sci, int[] paper) {
        List<int[]> list = new ArrayList<>();
        list.add(new int[]{rock[0], 1});
        list.add(new int[]{sci[0], 2});
        list.add(new int[]{paper[0], 3});
        List<int[]> permutations = permute(list);
        int[][] result = new int[permutations.size()][3];
        for (int i = 0; i < permutations.size(); i++) {
            result[i] = permutations.get(i);
        }
        return result;
    }

    static List<int[]> permute(List<int[]> nums) {
        List<List<int[]>> results = new ArrayList<>();
        backtrackPermute(nums, new ArrayList<>(), results);
        return results.stream().map(l -> l.toArray(new int[0])).collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

    static void backtrackPermute(List<int[]> nums, List<int[]> path, List<List<int[]>> results) {
        if (nums.isEmpty()) {
            results.add(new ArrayList<>(path));
            return;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < nums.size(); i++) {
            List<int[]> remaining = new ArrayList<>(nums);
            int[] current = remaining.remove(i);
            path.add(current);
            backtrackPermute(remaining, path, results);
            path.remove(path.size() - 1);
        }
    }
}
